target: Supplemental Seattle small-startup sources to reach 100 jobs

summary.assessment: CRITICAL FINDING: None of the supplemental sources (TopStartups.io, Built In Seattle, GeekWire 200, YC Work at a Startup, Otta, Indeed) yielded jobs at companies with 2-50 employees. All scraped jobs were at companies with 101+ employees. The 2-50 employee startup job market is primarily served by Wellfound (AngelList), which is already being scanned by the WellfoundScout peer. These supplemental sources are NOT viable for the 2-50 employee target and should not be counted toward the 100-job goal.

sites_scanned.rationale: Rich structured data (company, role, size, funding, apply URL) across 14 pages. Excellent scraper-friendly HTML. BUT: zero companies in 2-50 range. All 156 jobs are at 101+ employee companies (mostly 201-5000+). Good for supplemental context on larger startups but does not serve the small-startup target. Company size badges and funding info are valuable for context.
sites_scanned.data_quality: High (structured HTML with company size, funding, experience requirements)

sites_scanned.rationale: Server-rendered HTML with JSON-LD structured data. 25 jobs visible on first page. BUT: no company size data in job cards (only available on company profile pages). Most visible jobs are at large companies (Comcast, Snap, JPMorganChase, Airwallex). Company size filter parameter exists but doesn't actually filter — returns same results. No 2-50 employee company visibility.
sites_scanned.data_quality: Medium (JSON-LD available but missing company size in cards)
sites_scanned.scrape_difficulty: Medium (Alpine.js rendering, but JSON-LD fallback works)

sites_scanned.rationale: Cloudflare WAF blocks curl requests entirely. Web search reveals top companies (Helion Energy, Temporal, Truveta, Chainguard) but no job listings. The GeekWire 200 is a ranking index, not a job board. GeekWork (their job board) is at geekwire.com/jobs/ but also blocked. Cannot extract job data programmatically. Requires browser automation.
sites_scanned.blocking: Cloudflare WAF - returns 'You are unable to access geekwire.com'

sites_scanned.rationale: JS-rendered SPA, curl returns empty shell. Requires browser automation or API access. Web search confirms platform exists and has Seattle companies (Moonset Health, Silurian, Clearly AI, Terrakotta) but cannot extract listings. YC companies tend to be well-funded and may exceed 50 employees by hiring stage.

Requires account creation and login to view any jobs. No public job listings accessible via curl. Search engine returns no indexable job pages. Cannot extract data without authentication. Platform is designed for curated candidate matching, not open job browsing.
sites_scanned.scrape_difficulty: Very Hard (requires account, no public API)

sites_scanned.rationale: Cloudflare WAF blocks all automated requests. Returns 'Blocked - Indeed.com' page. Indeed's algorithm prioritizes large advertisers, burying small startup listings. Even with browser access, filtering for 2-50 employees requires clicking through multiple filters manually. Not viable for programmatic scraping.
Empty response from curl. Likely JS-rendered or requires specific headers. Niche AI job board that may have small startup data but cannot be accessed programmatically.
Empty response from curl. JS-rendered SPA. May have good small startup data but requires browser automation to access.

recommendations: The 2-50 employee target is NOT served by any of these supplemental sources. All scraped data is from 101+ employee companies.
Primary source for 2-50 employee startups remains Wellfound (AngelList) — already being scanned by WellfoundScout peer.
GeekWire 200 requires browser automation (Playwright/Puppeteer) to access — consider as a future hunt target.
YC Work at a Startup also requires browser automation but may have early-stage companies closer to target size.
Otta requires account creation — could be worthwhile if Aaron creates a profile for curated matching.
For truly small (2-10 employee) startups, LinkedIn connections and local meetups (AI Tinkerers Seattle) may be more effective than job boards.
Consider adding Wellfound API access or LinkedIn job search as alternative supplemental sources.
